name: CS50.ai (CS50 Duck, Explain Highlighted Code, style50, Duck on Ed)

used_where.name: CS50x, Harvard on campus (~500 students Fall 2023) and 10 other CS50 MOOCs

ai_does: GPT-4 (Azure) behind a unified backend: chat duck, explain highlighted code and style50 explanations in VS Code, auto-replies on the Ed forum (RAG over lecture captions, staff endorse/amend/delete); guardrails = system prompts that guide not answer, PII removal, prompt-injection guard, 10-hearts throttle

scale.value: >50,000 unique users, >1.8M queries, peak 25,000 prompts/day, cost ~$1.90/student/month

evidence.summary: Fall 2023 survey ~500 students: mid-term 47% 'very helpful' + 26% 'helpful'; end 73% responded, 53% 'loved' + 33% 'liked'. Reuse at other universities: none documented in the papers (unverified).
